newsitem.title: UK: European veg oils close steady to slightly firmer.
newsitem.headline: European veg oils close steady to slightly firmer.

text.p: European vegetable oils closed steady to slightly firmer following the slightly higher close of the Malaysian palm oil futures.
The continued upward trend seen in early Chicago soybean oil futures trading was also a midly bullish factor.
Crude palm oil finished unchanged to $2.50 up, with trade ranging on Jun at $542.50, Jul/Sep at $542.50/545 and Oct/Dec at $540.
The only other trade in the palm oil sector was for olein material, which ranged from Jun at $580 through to Oct/Dec at $557.50.
The soft oils closed one to 1.25 guilders above Wednesday's close. Soy oil traded Jun at 99.50 and Jul at 100 guilders, while rape oil changed hands at 101.75 on Aug/Oct.
Coconut oil drifted fairly aimlessly and ended the day unchanged to $2.50 firmer. Jun/Jul attracted the most of what trade there was, with trades of $635, $640 and $645.
